svg.aria-label: Where authorization happens · two enforcement models behind one AgentCore Gateway
svg.title: Where authorization happens · two enforcement models behind one AgentCore Gateway
svg.text: Where authorization happens · two enforcement models behind one AgentCore Gateway
The IdP puts a `team` claim in the login token · the gateway authenticates every call, but only decides for the backend that cannot decide for itself
AWS Cloud · one gateway, one inbound authorizer
MODEL B · gateway authorizes for the backend
JWKS: the backend checks the token itself

A · the gateway brokers identity (OBO token exchange) and team-a/b verify JWKS + `team` and answer 403 themselves. B · team-c cannot read tokens, so the REQUEST interceptor checks `team` and stops the call; outbound carries only a static API key.
